generation.directive: Write absolutely everything in English: the scene text, every line of dialogue, the names of places, objects and characters, and every field of your JSON answer. No French, no other language — except the `visual` fragments, which are explicitly asked for in English anyway.

agreement.masculin: masculine — refer to the player as « he/him » whenever a pronoun is needed, and use masculine nouns (barman, sir) when someone addresses him
agreement.feminin: feminine — refer to the player as « she/her » whenever a pronoun is needed, and use feminine nouns (barmaid, ma'am) when someone addresses her
agreement.neutre: neutral — refer to the player as « they/them », and avoid gendered nouns and forms of address entirely

generation.naming_form: The naming forms given above are French. Keep their INTENT, not their articles: an English place name takes « The Drowned Street », « The Underpass », « The Neon of … », « … Corner », never a literal translation of a French article.
generation.caps_note: The Title Case rule applies as written: English common nouns are lowercase, so a capital stays a clear signal. Capitalise every significant word of an interactive name, keep « the », « of », « to » lowercase inside it.
generation.vocabulary:
IMPOSED LEXICON — the world is cyberpunk, not medieval.
The way out is an AIRLOCK. Never write « door », « gate », « threshold » or « portal »: it is an airlock, and that exact word must appear in the « Exits: » line and in the action verb.
Likewise: the starting bar is a bar, with its counter and its bartender, never an inn, a tavern or an innkeeper — and it is the only bar of the night; neon, screens and tubes, never torches, lanterns or candles; cables and structures, never beams.
generation.address: Address the player as « you », second person singular, plain and direct — never formal or archaic.

ui.lang.label: Language
ui.lang.hint: The whole night will be written in this language: the story, the characters, and what you type.
ui.login.tagline_line2: towards a resolution that belongs to you.
ui.login.dossier_known: The bureau already has your file
ui.login.dossier_named: In the name of {{name}} — nothing to fill in, the city is waiting.
ui.login.disclaimer_1: The admission form is used only to generate your personalised adventure — characters, places, quest. No account, no social network, no third party.
ui.login.disclaimer_2: Your answers are not recorded on any server: we do not store them, share them or sell them.
ui.login.disclaimer_3: They stay on this device, in your browser, for the length of your adventure — {{days}} days — so that you can pick it up where you left it.
ui.login.disclaimer_4: Clearing your answers from the form, or clearing this site's data, removes them.
ui.admission.step1_legend: The bureau records who presents themselves.
ui.admission.step2_legend: Where you come from, where you sleep.
ui.admission.step3_legend: Three answers. The night will use them without ever quoting them.
ui.admission.step4_legend: The time your life changed street.
ui.admission.step5_legend: Four details. The night will put them back in front of you.
ui.admission.step6_legend: The service records how you spend your nights.
ui.admission.latin_hint: Optional. Your name is written in a script no number can be drawn from: in this form, the night can weigh it. You will always be called by your written name.
ui.admission.birthday_hint: The bureau checks the day; the hour is of no interest.
ui.admission.agreement_hint: We will write to you as « {{example}} ».
ui.admission.current_city_hint: The city of the night will hold on to it: streets, rain, habits.
ui.admission.touchstones_intro: One line each, as it comes. Nothing to explain: the city will know what to do with it.
ui.admission.moment_hint: Where, at what hour, under what light. The night will not give it back: it will find its colour again.
ui.admission.fear_film: The film that scared you most
ui.admission.fear_film_hint: It will never be named. The city will only know how it scared you.
ui.admission.animal_hint: Keep your eyes open: it is out tonight too.
ui.admission.anthem_hint: We will not quote it. The city, though, never lets it finish.
ui.admission.turning_intro: Optional, but this is what gives the night something to recognise you by. One line is enough.
ui.admission.keepsake: An object you hold on to
ui.admission.refuge: Where you go when things go wrong
ui.admission.ally_ph: we will ask nothing more of you
ui.admission.nights_intro: Everyone has them. It is the ones spent outside that interest us: there is no wrong answer, only undeclared hours.
ui.admission.awake: The nights you do not sleep
ui.admission.awake_hint: Outside, preferably: what happens between four walls gives the city nothing to build with.
ui.admission.dream_hint: The one that RETURNS: the night can set it down in front of you without repeating itself. If none comes back, leave the line empty.
ui.admission.required_hint: First name and date of birth are required. The rest is not.
ui.verdict.title: Admitted
ui.verdict.p1: Your file went before the night commission. Eleven thousand applications this week; fourteen accepted. Yours is one of them.
ui.verdict.p2: This is not chance: the city only lets in those whose name rings true. Yours was weighed, checked, accepted. What you declared here, the night will use — your cities, your attachments, what you left behind, and how you spend your nights.
ui.verdict.p3_strong: A temporary right of passage is granted to you.
ui.verdict.p3_rest: Report to the bar at the far end of the night. You are expected already, and the rain is not going to stop.

ui.game.psycho_prompt: Find the sign that comes next.

ui.game.action_locked: You need something to read with

ui.oracle.missing: Something is missing: nobody leaves here without it.
ui.oracle.holder_knows: {{name}} knows more than they let on.
ui.oracle.found_item: What you need is on nobody: it is written right here, and it takes the lens to read it.
ui.oracle.takeable: Not everything goes through people: whatever the story writes in Capitals, you can touch, and several of those things can be picked up.
ui.oracle.missing_piece: You're still missing a piece of a card, lying somewhere in this place. Nobody will hand it to you: look for what wears a Capital.
ui.oracle.use_lens: Use it before you leave: the lens opens the scrambled names in the text, and what they say is worth the detour.
ui.oracle.just_exit: All that is left is to step through {{exit}}.
ui.oracle.no_name: You don't know their name yet. The eye, top left, reads identities.
ui.oracle.unread_object: You can't read its name yet. The lens, in the toolbar, opens the scrambled names in the text — you don't pick up what you can't name.
ui.oracle.unused_lens: You are holding {{tool}} and you have not used it yet. The lens, in the toolbar, opens the scrambled names in the text — there is something here to read before you push the door.
ui.oracle.unused_lens_tool: what you have just been handed
ui.locked.the_end: All good things come to an end
ui.game.facing_hint: You are talking to them — click to turn away (Esc)
ui.payment_success.title: The airlock knows you
ui.payment_success.body: The lock's light turns green. Your access is open for the rest of the night: nothing keeps you at the counter any longer.
ui.payment_success.ready: Everything you need to accomplish it is already on you. Outside, the rain is waiting for your step.
ui.oracle.puzzle_frequency: What you need is on no one: it is a frequency. Read its name with the lens, then find what narrows it down in this place — look at whatever wears a Capital.
ui.oracle.puzzle_code: What you need is on no one: it is a four-digit code. Read its name with the lens, then look at whatever wears a Capital: it is written in this place.
ui.oracle.puzzle_sequence: What you need is on no one: it is a sequence of gestures. Read its name with the lens, then look at whatever wears a Capital: their order is written in this place.
ui.oracle.puzzle_lock: What you need, this place gives to whoever shows the right card — one you already carry. Read its name with the lens, then look at whatever wears a Capital: this place tells you which.
ui.oracle.puzzle_search: What you need is hidden here. Look at whatever wears a Capital before you search: this place tells you where.
ui.oracle.puzzle_carried: One of the pieces is not here: you picked it up earlier tonight without knowing. What you carry reads differently in every place.
ui.puzzle.freq_range: Scratched by hand into the paint: “between {{lo}} and {{hi}}”.
ui.puzzle.freq_sum: In tiny marker: “its two digits add up to {{sum}}”.
ui.puzzle.freq_value: Scratched by hand into the paint, next to a wave symbol: “{{value}} MHz”.
ui.puzzle.code_value: Scrawled in full, easy to read: “{{code}}”.
ui.puzzle.seq_order: Instructions copied out by hand, in order: {{steps}}.
ui.puzzle.lock_clue: Near the reader, someone has written: “{{place}}”. It wants the card taken there.
ui.puzzle.search_here: On {{spot}}, the dust has been disturbed, and recently: that's where it is hidden.
ui.puzzle.search_known: You know what you are looking for. Now find where it is hidden.
ui.puzzle.search_found: You search {{spot}}. Under your fingers, a rigid rectangle, worn at the corners.
ui.puzzle.halves_joined: The two halves lock together, break against break. The card is whole, and its edge is exactly the shade of the ring around the reader's slot, by the passage.
ui.puzzle.reader_waits: The passage doesn't give. Beside it, the reader's slot waits, empty.
ui.puzzle.reader_open: {{name}} wakes: its slot is waiting for a card.
ui.puzzle.reader_hint: It only takes a whole card.
ui.puzzle.unlocked_frequency: {{name}} is waiting for a frequency. What narrows it down is somewhere in this place.
ui.puzzle.unlocked_code: {{name}} is waiting for four digits. Look around: they are written in this place.
ui.puzzle.unlocked_sequence: {{name}} is waiting for a sequence of gestures. Look around: their order is written in this place.
ui.puzzle.unlocked_lock: {{name}} only gives way to the right card — one you already carry, taken earlier in the night. Look around: this place tells you which.
ui.puzzle.solved_frequency: The frequency locks. The noise goes quiet.
ui.puzzle.solved_sequence: The gestures follow one another. Something gives.
ui.puzzle.solved_lock: The reader swallows the card, and gives it back.
ui.puzzle.hint: The answer is written in this place: look at whatever wears a Capital.
ui.puzzle.hint_frequency: The clues are in this place: look at whatever wears a Capital.
ui.puzzle.hint_carried: The clues are in this place, all but one: it travels with you.
ui.puzzle.no_cards: You have no card to show.
ui.game.howto_look_body: Whatever is written **in bold and with a Capital** in the story is really there, in the room. Click it to examine it: under the mouse, the cursor turns back into an arrow and the word is underlined. On a phone there is no hover and nothing gets underlined: just tap the word with your finger, even with the eye open, and the examination starts at once. You can also type what you do with it: look, take, open. Some things nobody will hand you — you have to find them.
ui.game.howto_talk_body: People's names are scrambled. Tap the **bionic eye** button, then bring it onto a name: it deciphers, and you can talk to that person. A simple hello is enough to start the conversation, or ask them a question straight away.
ui.game.howto_trade_body: Some things are worth more to someone else. While you are talking to a person, open **On you** and tap **Give** on an object. If it is what they were waiting for, they keep it and return the favour: what they know about your quest, an object you need, or something hidden in the scenery. If not, they hand it back.
ui.game.eye_body_1: This button switches on the eye. It reads people's names: bring it onto one of them, and the name deciphers itself.
ui.game.eye_body_2: Everyone here has their own note, and you hear it the moment you recognise them. Turn the sound on.

story: You wear it {{item_worn}}. It does not replace your eye: it completes it. Your eye tunes itself to people until it recognises them; this one opens the names of things, which answer to no one.
And reading is not the point: {{item_action}}

story_fallbacks.item_why: Outside, nothing carries a readable name. With this, it does.
story_fallbacks.item_description: A dull, lukewarm lens, heavier than it looks.
story_fallbacks.item_action: that is what a name, once read, will let you do, and could not do before.

howto_pointer: Pick the lens from the toolbar at the top of the scene. The cursor changes shape: that is what you are holding.
Move over a scrambled object name and STOP on it. After a moment, the analysis opens.
Switch back to the eye to read people's names: the two do not read the same thing.
howto_gyro: Pick the lens from the toolbar at the top of the scene.
Tilt the device to bring the eye onto a scrambled object name, and HOLD IT STILL there. After a moment, the analysis opens.
Switch back to the eye to read people's names: the two do not read the same thing.
augmentation_primer.caps_note: The Capitals in the story are what you can touch. And not everything is handed over in conversation: some things are simply lying there, named in the middle of the text, that nobody will offer you and that you will only find by looking closely.
augmentation_primer.footer: A name you have read does not remember itself. The game will not remember it for you.

paywall.gate_text:
Your hand closes on the steel handle of the airlock. The metal is cold. Behind it, the rain, and the rest of your night.

The airlock does not open yet.

pitch.eyebrow: What is at stake for you

generative.title: A night no one has ever played
generative.text: This is not a script dressed up with your name: there is nothing underneath. Nor is it chance: nothing is drawn at random. Every place, every face, every line, every image is deduced from your admission file and from what you did just before, and is built the moment you walk in. This night happens once; it will not be played again for anyone.

points.label: What pulls tight in you
points.text: “{{tension}}” This is what the game read in your file. No one in that first room named it: each of them answered it in their own way.

points.label: Where it is pulling
points.text: “{{release}}” This is not a promise: it is a direction.

points.label: By what means
points.text: By playing, and nothing else. No one will explain this tension to you, or how to undo it: what you choose to do decides it. The game reads every move you make and builds what follows on it.

points.label: What you take away
points.text: The knot that comes undone in the fiction is the same one as in your life. You leave with something you can use, not with a score.

pitch.closing: On the other side of the airlock, the rain has not stopped falling. It is waiting for your step.

messages.scenes: You already have your world. Step through the airlock to see what follows.
messages.turns: The night ends here for you. The airlock is still there.
messages.images: This room already has a face.

messages.scenes: You have travelled a great deal this month. The world needs to breathe.
messages.turns: It has been a long night. Come back tomorrow.

lock.message: The city is recharging. Come back when it has finished.
lock.completed_message: This story went all the way. It does not play twice.
